entities.summary: Lai Yawen is a Chinese former volleyball player and two-time Olympian. As a player, Lai competed with the national team at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona, where she finished seventh. She then won a silver medal with the national team at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta.
